question: Related Questions Q. We have a grain store and we have given it on lease for 11 months. We get Rs 8000/- every month. 1649 views Q. I am a member of the managing committee of the building society in which we reside. The society comprises of 33 members, mostly muslims. We have got advertisement hoardings on the terrace through which, we generate good revenue. Every year we give gifts to all society members in the form of eatables etc. This year we decided to gift dry fruits. All the managing committee members went to the market to purchase the dry fruits for and on behalf of all the society members. After purchasing the dry fruits one of the managing committe members requested for some personal gift from the shop keeper. As the purchase was a huge amount, the shopkeeper gifted all the managing committee members some chocolates which they kept for personal use. I did not object at that time, but later decided that i would give the gift away in sadkah from the society's side and requested the other members to do the same. They all refused to give the choclates away. I told them three times but they still kept for personal use. Please tell me: Is keeping the gift allowed, when we went to purchase material for the society? How can we take personal favors from the shopkeeper? 2. Is giving it away in sadkah correct? Please reply at the earliest. 1488 views Q. I have a Mango plantation 40 km from my place, I am working in a company and my father states with me and is too old to look after the plantation. This being the case is it permissible for me to give it on lease for 3-5years? 1829 views Q. In izzalatul khifa, did he he gives qoutes for the dalail of hazrat umer in support of state ownership of land?? Stateownership is Communism. I am so confused please please help. I will be really thankful. Please answer my all questions and sorry for the long question. Please solve my confusion. 1910 views Q. As Salamualaikum Wo Rahmatullahi Wo Barakatuhu, Dear Respected Mufti sahaab, This is Shahbaaz here currently i am staying here in Dubai since 1 year, almost some 8 months back i had a neighbour from some other country, while he was leaving to his country he had given few things like washing machine, bed and a suitecase of clothes to keep with us and he told he will return back in 2 months and collect them, it is almost 8 months now and he has not come back to us. But no confirmation of re-pricing. Is is permissible to buy or not? 1897 views Q. I am paying heavy deposit to the owner of a house refundable after three years without any interest agaist which he is giving me his property (house/shop) which I want to rent to third person. After 3 years or as per contract when owner return my deposit, I will release his property. In this case owner is getting deposit for said period which is interest free. I am getting passasion of property for which I am getting rent from third party. This is called "Sub Leasing". Kindly let me know what is Shariyah's ruling about Sub Lease. 2361 views Q. Dealings or Stealings 1708 views Q. PLEASE TELL ME ABOUT LEASING?OR DOING JOB IN LEASING COMPANY ACCORDING TO ISLAMIC RULES OR NOT? 1974 views Q. Currently there is a difference of opinion regarding what is known as ?Islamic Banking.? There are some ulama that are of the opinion that this type of banking and the services that they provide are halaal and a practicing Muslim should have not fear and fully take advantage of the variety of services being offered by these same banks. On the other hand there are a group of scholars that aver that this type of banking is no different than regular commercial non Islamic banks. The only differences being in the terminology, but the actual transactions fall into the category of riba. Our question to the ulama ikram is: in the opinion of your darul iftaa, which group is correct, as both can not be correct in this case. Please explain your fatwa completely which will eliminate the doubts in the minds of the common people. 2589 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 134 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I have been working with bank for more then 14 years. Is the monet I earned OK? Question: I would like to ask a very important question related to my work. I have been working with bank for more then 14 years. I have been paid the salary for the time and services for the bank. Please advise if the money I earned is OK ? Answer ID: 134 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 529/H=337/H) According to Hadith, those are cursed who take interest, give it, write it, and who give witness to it. If you avoided all these things in your job then your earnings are lawful for you. And, when you are in Saudi Arabia we hope that your job is OK. But, we do not know what kind of banking system is prevalent there. However, if any question arises in your mind then better contact the local Ulama and Muftis regarding the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
